newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate flat at 9.7 percent.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate flat at 9.7 percent.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate remained flat at 9.7 pct on Monday, despite fears that stronger kuna demand might push the price of money up.
Settlements totalled 33.7 million kuna, of which almost 20 million were fresh borrowings, but they left a shortage of some 15 million, also sought by banks.
Lenders rolled over old placements at steady rates of 9.0 to 12 percent, depending on term, dealers said.
The central bank's kuna midrates for Tuesday eased to 5.5369 to the dollar and firmed very slightly to 3.5621 to the German mark. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
